sources.text: Vaud, more formally Canton of Vaud, is one of the 26 cantons forming the Swiss Confederation. It is composed of ten districts; its capital city is Lausanne. Its coat of arms bears the motto "Liberté et Patrie" on a white-green bicolour.

sources.text: Simplon tunnel opens (1906): The rail tunnel between Brig and Domodossola opens.
sources.label: Key event · Simplon tunnel opens

sources.text: First World War: active service (1914–1918): The army guards the borders under General Wille; food and fuel become scarce and social tensions grow.
sources.label: Key event · First World War: active service

sources.text: General strike and Spanish flu (1918): The national general strike of 12–14 November is ended by the army; the influenza pandemic kills about 25,000 people in Switzerland (1918–1919).
sources.label: Key event · General strike and Spanish flu

sources.text: First National Council election by proportional representation (1919): Proportional representation, accepted in 1918, ends the absolute majority of the Free Democrats.
sources.label: Key event · First National Council election by proportional representation

sources.text: Switzerland joins the League of Nations (1920): Voters accept membership; Geneva becomes the League's seat.
